verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Brex exposes its own official MCP server (developer.brex.com/docs/mcp) for others to call Brex's tools, i.e. Brex acting as an MCP server/provider — not that Brex itself can act as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools. No documentation or community evidence describes Brex consuming/connecting to third-party MCP servers.
